codeText:
# Experimental syntax: facts and type contracts stay in REL.
module story

view experiment.page.story of @TheStory isa Page:
  P.subject: source
  P.title: source.S.Title
  P.paragraphs: source.S.Content
  P.route: "encounter-story.html"
  edit P.title through source.S.Title
  show as StoryPage

view experiment.nav.story of @TheStory isa NavigationItem:
  N.label: source.S.Title
  N.target: source
  edit N.label through source.S.Title

  in @experiment.WebMainMenu:
    N.label: "The story"
    edit N.label here
    show as WebLink:
      page: @experiment.page.story

  in @experiment.MainframeStories:
    show as MainframeRow:
      option: "01"
      open: @experiment.openStory

representation WebLink:
  given navigation as NavigationItem
  given page as Page
  require page.P.subject equals navigation.N.target
  return WebLink:
    W.text: navigation.N.label
    W.href: page.P.route
  render:
    tag: "a"
    attrs:
      id: "experiment-web-link"
      href: result.W.href
    children:
      - result.W.text
  events:
    - selector: "#experiment-web-link"
      open: page

representation MainframeRow:
  given navigation as NavigationItem
  given option as text
  given open as StoryPanelAction
  return MainframeRow:
    R.option: option
    R.label: navigation.N.label
    R.target: navigation.N.target
  render:
    tag: "table"
    attrs:
      class: "experiment-row"
    children:
      - tag: "tbody"
        children:
          - tag: "tr"
            children:
              - tag: "td"
                children:
                  - result.R.option
              - tag: "td"
                children:
                  - tag: "button"
                    attrs:
                      id: "experiment-mainframe-row"
                      type: "button"
                    children:
                      - result.R.label
  events:
    - selector: "#experiment-mainframe-row"
      run: open.A.process
      arguments:
        story: navigation.N.target

representation StoryPage:
  given navigation as Page
  return Page:
    P.subject: navigation.P.subject
    P.title: navigation.P.title
    P.paragraphs: navigation.P.paragraphs
    P.route: navigation.P.route
  render:
    tag: "article"
    children:
      - tag: "h2"
        children:
          - result.P.title
      - each paragraph in result.P.paragraphs:
        tag: "p"
        children:
          - paragraph

representation OpenStory:
  given story as Story
  return StoryPanel:
    P.title: story.S.Title
    P.paragraphs: story.S.Content
  render:
    tag: "article"
    children:
      - tag: "h2"
        children:
          - result.P.title
      - each paragraph in result.P.paragraphs:
        tag: "p"
        children:
          - paragraph
factText:
// Story data and explicitly addressed contexts. Facts remain REL.
("TheStory", "isa", "Story")
("TheStory", "S.Title", "What happened")
("TheStory", "S.Content", "TheStory.first")
("TheStory", "S.Content", "TheStory.second")
("experiment.WebMainMenu", "isa", "Context")
("experiment.WebMainMenu", "C.view", "experiment.nav.story")
("experiment.MainframeStories", "isa", "Context")
("experiment.MainframeStories", "C.view", "experiment.nav.story")
("experiment.openStory", "isa", "StoryPanelAction")
("experiment.openStory", "A.process", "OpenStory")
("experiment.openStory", "A.accepts", "Story")
("experiment.openStory", "A.effect", "local-navigation")

("TheStory.first", "isa", "TextEntry")
("TheStory.first", "E.value", "The story is long and complicated")
("TheStory.second", "isa", "TextEntry")
("TheStory.second", "E.value", "It started 150 years ago")
